file explorer pane header -- renders fixed operator label 'OPEN EDITORS' and file management controls
collapsed pane header -- renders fixed operator label 'OUTLINE'
timeline pane header -- renders fixed operator label 'TIMELINE'
editor tab bar controls -- renders fixed operator actions for closing and splitting tabs; tab labels are user-named files and remain masked
getting started header -- renders fixed operator product name and subtitle
getting started left column -- renders fixed operator headings and action buttons for New File, Go to File, Open Folder, Source Control, and Remote
getting started right column -- renders fixed operator category titles and descriptions for built-in learning paths
getting started footer -- renders fixed operator checkbox and label for 'Show on Startup'
status bar -- renders fixed operator status indicators and labels for host, SCM, problems, ports, and notifications
